notes: Adds a temporary hot-loader diagnostic wrapper around Item.update on Foundry builds older than 14.368.
Captures the exact Item, owner, changed paths, raw identifier, and rejected validation error for every identifier failure during one loader run.
Restores the original Item.update method before the loader exits and stores the last trace at globalThis.__FEHA_LAST_IDENTIFIER_FAILURES.
Shows one FEHA TRACE summary notification after the loader completes when failures were captured.
No gameplay, catalog, balance, manufacturer, armor, or observer behavior changes are introduced.
